selected.claim: Making task continuation an affine/linear Clay semantic fiber can structurally fence stale same-lease task-derived material across state, GWT use, re-entry, reward, effect and completion boundaries.

strongest_counterhypothesis.claim: An ordinary nested task fence with task epoch, material revision, consent-witness binding and idempotency checked at the same boundaries achieves the same defect coverage with lower cost and complexity.

promotion_rule: LICF may only survive if it gains unique defect coverage, static proof leverage, architecture compression, recovery integrity or resource benefit over the strongest conventional baseline. Equal correctness with higher cost => NO PROMOTION.
current_prediction: Conventional baseline likely matches runtime semantic coverage; LICF may only retain future value if ClayCode linear typing can prove boundary completeness statically.
